mechanism: Bisacodyl's stimulant laxative effects combined with tranylcypromine (MAOI) may increase risk of hypertensive crisis if bisacodyl causes electrolyte depletion or if formulations contain sympathomimetic additives.
action: Use alternative non-stimulant laxatives (osmotic or stool softeners) in patients taking MAOIs; if bisacodyl is necessary, monitor blood pressure and electrolytes closely.
